outcome.answer: You can inspect internal activations during inference by reading hidden states or attention traces and compressing them into lightweight descriptors, rather than adding extra forward passes or external judges [1]. A concrete systems approach is to decouple observability from the inference hot path with asynchronous tensor capture, which can collect layer-wise activations with low overhead while preserving serving speed [7]. Another practical option is to use activation-level interpretability tooling that streams activations during generation and supports real-time control with reduced memory and latency cost [4].
